lead: A `.lspt` case that writes `$u = new User();` records no member entry at all.
body: `var` is what declares a variable, so a bare assignment is `E0301` and the receiver has no type — the checker still records `ExprInfo::New` for the `new`, and nothing for `$u->name`, so a `definition` or `hover` case on the member answers `none` while the same case on the class name passes. Write `var $u = new User();` in any case whose cursor is on a member.
